label: April 13–19
title: “Stand Still, and See the Salvation of the Lord” —  Exodus 14

items.text: Fear ye not. Stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord. The Lord shall fight for you. When we feel trapped and need a little more faith to see the salvation of the Lord, we can remember how the Lord saved Israel that day.

Let us be strong like unto Moses; for he truly spake unto the waters of the Red Sea and they divided hither and thither, and our fathers came through, out of captivity, on dry ground. We can be strong in faith.

When we feel trapped—when we need a little more faith to “see the salvation of the Lord”—we can remember how “the Lord saved Israel that day.” This ancient story continues to inspire faith and courage.
As you read about Israel’s journey, ponder how the Lord has made bitter things in your life sweet. What value have these experiences had in your life? Trust in God more, and murmur less.

The Lord often compares spiritual things to food. Look for His spiritual lessons in the Israelites’ experiences with manna in Exodus 16. He offers us daily spiritual nourishment, just as He provided for them.
What does the Lord give me that is like the daily manna He gave the Israelites? What can I do that is like gathering manna? Seek daily spiritual experiences and nourishment from Him.
Think of the Savior as you read Exodus 17:1–7. How is Jesus Christ like a rock to you? He is our spiritual rock and living water, offering sustenance and stability in all our trials.
The Israelites sang a song of praise after the Lord parted the Red Sea. Which phrases in this song do you find especially meaningful? Let us praise the Lord for His mighty acts in our lives.
Consider whether you have ever murmured or complained during difficult times. What do you learn from the Israelites’ experiences that can help you murmur less and trust God more in your challenges?
When God’s people have needed faith and courage, they have told the story of the Red Sea. This story inspires us to seek God’s power in our lives and remember how He has helped us before.
